Nel 2023 Sony ha inviato comunicazioni u: In 2023 Sony sent official notices to some PlayStation Store users, informing them that films previously purchased through distribution agreements with Discovery - including original productions and documentary series - would be removed from their digital libraries within thirty days.
Il motivo dichiarato: la scadenza del co: The stated reason: the expiry of the licensing contract between Sony and the distributor. Users did not receive automatic refunds. The files could not be downloaded to local storage. At the end of the grace period, access to the content was irrevocably revoked by the platform.
Quando si acquista un film su PlayStatio: When you buy a film on PlayStation Store, you don't buy the video file. You buy a {0}licence to use it{/0}, valid as long as the contract between Sony and the distributor remains active. When the contract expires or is not renewed, the platform can remove that content from users' libraries - including from those who had legitimately "bought" it.
Sony ha difeso la pratica citando i prop: Sony defended the practice by citing its Terms of Service, which clearly state that digital purchases are temporary licences and not permanent ownership of the file. A clause found in the ToS of almost every digital content platform.
Gli utenti colpiti hanno perso l'accesso: Affected users lost access to the titles they had purchased with no way of recovering them. No automatic refund was offered. Those who had bought several films found their library shrunk without adequate notice. Some users who contacted Sony support obtained store credit as partial compensation, but only after repeated requests and without a consistent policy.
Perché riguarda anche il collezionismo: Why it matters for collectors too
Un Blu-ray acquistato fisicamente è ripr: A physically purchased Blu-ray can be played as long as the player works and the disc doesn't deteriorate, regardless of any commercial agreement between third-party companies. A digitally purchased film exists as access only as long as all the parties involved - platform, distributor, film studio - decide to keep it available. Physical collecting guarantees a simple, verifiable chain of ownership: you buy, you own, you keep, you resell.
Questo caso documenta con precisione la: This case precisely documents the difference between buying content and obtaining a temporary licence to use it. With physical media, the chain of ownership is simple: you buy, you own. With digital, the chain is complex: you get a licence that depends on a commercial agreement between platform and distributor, which may expire or not be renewed, resulting in loss of access - with no guaranteed refund.
Take-Two Interactive e Rockstar Games ha: Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar Games have confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI will be available in a "physical" version for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S - but without a disc. The box, identical in appearance to traditional ones, will contain a download code instead of the optical disc. The game, estimated at over 150 GB, will have to be downloaded entirely from the internet.
La decisione ha generato immediate reazi: The decision sparked immediate reactions in the gaming community and among retailers, opening a debate on the very meaning of the term "physical edition".
La produzione di dischi Blu-ray UHD per: Producing UHD Blu-ray discs for video games involves significant production and logistics costs. Companies in the sector have gradually reduced physical print runs, pushing towards digital to maximise margins. The "Code in a Box" keeps distribution through traditional retail channels - shelves, pre-orders, physical launch - without the costs of producing the optical disc. For the publisher it's a cost-effective solution; for the consumer, the implications are different.
Un \"Code in a Box\" non è rivendibile c: A "Code in a Box" cannot be resold like a physical disc. It cannot be lent. It is not collectable in the traditional sense of the word. The box is empty in terms of content: it's a plastic container holding a piece of paper. Access to the game depends entirely on the available internet connection and on the continued operation of the relevant digital store.
In caso di chiusura dello store o di pro: If the store closes or there are account problems, the code could become unusable. There is no digital equivalent of "put the disc in and play".
GTA V è uno dei titoli più scambiati sul: GTA V has been one of the most traded titles on the second-hand market for over a decade. Special editions, limited edition boxes and mint copies hold a recognisable collectable value and real liquidity. GTA VI in its "Code in a Box" version will not feed the same secondary market. The box, without a disc, transfers nothing tangible: there is no possible second-hand market, no resale value guaranteed by the presence of the physical medium.
GTA VI rappresenta un momento di svolta: GTA VI marks a turning point in the debate on the meaning of "physical edition". When the box doesn't contain the game - only instructions to download it - the term "physical" becomes a matter of marketing rather than substance. For collectors, the distinction is fundamental: a box without a disc is an empty box.
Dopo l'annuncio della versione \"Code in: After the announcement of the "Code in a Box" version of GTA VI, some of the main European retailers officially announced their decision not to stock the product. GAME, the largest UK chain specialising in video games, publicly stated that it did not want to sell a box that does not contain the game itself. Similar positions came from Australian retailers and some Northern European chains.
I rivenditori fisici costruiscono il pro: Physical retailers build their business model on selling and reselling products with tangible value. A box with a download code doesn't generate qualified footfall in store, doesn't feed the second-hand market - one of the main revenue streams for specialist retailers - and offers the consumer no advantage over buying directly from the digital store.
Per GAME e retailer simili, stoccare un: For GAME and similar retailers, stocking a "Code in a Box" means giving up second-hand margins and competing directly with PlayStation Store and Xbox Live on a product where the physical shop's competitive advantage is zero.
In alcuni mercati, GTA VI nella sua vers: In some markets, GTA VI in its "physical" version will not be available in traditional shops. Those who want the box will have to rely on other distribution channels. Those who want real physical media - a disc, not a code - will have to wait for a possible alternative release or do without the boxed edition.
Il rifiuto collettivo dei rivenditori è: The collective refusal by retailers is an unusual and significant market signal. It represents an economic stance on the value of physical media as a guarantee of real content. It is, in essence, the retail market stating: a box without content does not have the same commercial value as a box with a disc. The distinction is not just ideological: it is monetary.
La resistenza dei rivenditori dimostra c: The retailers' resistance shows that the distinction between "box" and "physical media" is economically relevant and recognised by the market. It's not just an ideological debate among collectors: the retail market, in its commercial assessment, recognises that a product without tangible content has a different value.
Insomniac Games e Sony Interactive Enter: Insomniac Games and Sony Interactive Entertainment have confirmed that Marvel's Wolverine, expected as a PlayStation 5 exclusive, will include a Blu-ray disc in the physical box. The seemingly ordinary announcement took on particular significance in the context of the debate opened by GTA VI: it shows that choosing to distribute on physical disc is still possible and, for some publishers, still preferable.
Sony, con il proprio hardware proprietar: Sony, with its own proprietary hardware and first-party studios, has a direct interest in enhancing PlayStation exclusives through the traditional physical edition too. Insomniac can guarantee complete physical editions without having to negotiate with third-party distributors on how the content is delivered. Confirming the physical disc is, in all likelihood, also a commercial response to the controversy over Rockstar's choice.
Gli acquirenti di Marvel's Wolverine in: Buyers of the physical version of Marvel's Wolverine will get a Blu-ray disc playable without an internet connection, which can be kept indefinitely, resold on the second-hand market and lent. The game will remain accessible even if PlayStation Store were to close or the title were removed from the digital platform for any reason.
La conferma del disco per un titolo majo: Confirming the disc for a major title like Marvel's Wolverine signals that the collectors' market and physical-minded consumers still carry weight in publishers' decisions. A complete physical edition - with the disc in the box - retains a resale value and an appeal for collectors that a digital code alone cannot replicate over time.
La presenza del disco in Marvel's Wolver: The presence of the disc in Marvel's Wolverine shows that physical distribution is still technically and commercially viable for top-tier titles. Not including the disc in GTA VI is therefore a specific business decision, not a technical necessity of the market. Collectors can still expect complete physical editions from publishers that consciously choose to offer them.
Dal 2010 ad oggi, decine di store digita: Since 2010, dozens of digital stores have shut down or removed content previously purchased by users. Nintendo's Wii Shop Channel stopped sales in 2019 and closed completely in 2023. The PlayStation Store for PS3 and PSP was threatened with closure in 2021, before Sony reversed the decision following user protests.
L'Xbox 360 Marketplace ha cessato la ven: The Xbox 360 Marketplace stopped selling new content in 2024. Google Stadia - Google's cloud gaming service - closed in January 2023, leaving users without access to the games they had paid for (Google offered refunds, but the precedent remains). Ubisoft Connect removed legitimately purchased titles from some users' libraries, including {0}The Crew{/0}, citing the expiry of licensing rights for online content.
Ogni store digitale è un servizio commer: Every digital store is a commercial service that depends on licensing agreements, server maintenance costs and corporate strategic decisions. When a service is no longer economically sustainable, it is shut down. Digital content purchased through these stores is not stored locally: it consists of permissions to use files hosted on third-party servers, valid as long as the service remains active.
Il DRM (Digital Rights Management) - il: DRM (Digital Rights Management) - the copy protection system built into most digital content - is often tied to the platform's servers: when the server is switched off, the DRM stops responding and the content becomes inaccessible, even if the user has the file locally.
Chi ha investito somme significative in: Those who have invested significant sums in digital libraries find themselves in a position of structural vulnerability: they own nothing in a legal and practical sense. They can use that content only as long as all the necessary conditions are met at the same time: active internet connection, account in good standing, operating platform, licensing agreements in force between all the parties involved.
Il collezionista digitale non ha una pro: The digital collector has no ownership: they effectively have an indefinite subscription, which can be interrupted at any time by any of the parties in the commercial chain.
Il collezionismo fisico è, tra le altre: Physical collecting is, among other things, a system for preserving cultural memory that is independent of corporate dynamics. Vinyl, DVDs, Blu-rays, cartridges and game discs outlive the companies that made them. A 1985 Super Mario Bros. NES cartridge is still playable today. A title bought on a digital service that closed in 2015 cannot be recovered without resorting to unofficial copies.
La preservazione del patrimonio cultural: Preserving cultural heritage is one of the reasons why physical media continue to have a value that goes beyond mere functionality. Libraries, archives, museums and private collectors play a preservation role that commercial servers cannot guarantee in the long term.
Il dibattito tra fisico e digitale non r: The physical vs digital debate is not just about image quality or the convenience of buying. It's about the legal and economic nature of what it means to "own" cultural content. Physical media offer ownership that is transferable, preservable, resellable and independent of commercial services. Digital content offers a licence to use that is revocable, non-transferable and dependent on the continuity of a commercial service. Knowing the difference is the first step towards making informed choices.

Il 1° luglio 2026, tramite il PlayStatio: On 1 July 2026, through the official PlayStation Blog, Sony Interactive Entertainment announced that from January 2028 it will stop producing discs for all new games released on PlayStation consoles. After that date, new titles will be available exclusively in digital format, on PlayStation Store and through retailers. Games already released - or released before January 2028 - are not affected and will continue to exist on disc.
Secondo i dati di bilancio diffusi da So: According to the financial data released by Sony for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2025, digital downloads now account for 85% of full-game sales on PS4 and PS5, against 15% for physical copies. The company describes the choice as a natural adjustment to consumer preferences, which are clearly oriented towards digital. Reducing physical print runs also cuts printing, production and logistics costs.
Dal 2028, chi vorrà un nuovo gioco PlayS: From 2028, anyone who wants a new PlayStation game will have to buy it digitally. Sony has said it will continue to sell retail products after 2028, but it's not yet clear in what form: boxes with a code inside, or cards with a redemption code. Either way the actual disc would be gone - and with it the ability to resell, lend and keep the game independently of the store.
La fine della stampa dei dischi segna un: The end of disc printing marks a turning point for the second-hand and video game collectors' market. Games released on disc up to 2027 potentially become the last "real" physical media of this era: pieces set to gain growing collectable value over time. After 2028, without a disc, there is no secondary market and no transferable chain of ownership.
La decisione di Sony conferma su scala i: Sony's decision confirms on an industrial scale the trend that already emerged with GTA VI and the "Code in a Box": physical video game media are becoming the exception, not the rule. For those who care about truly owning what they buy - being able to keep, lend and resell - the discs produced up to 2027 represent a window that is closing.
